notes: Independent review findings are inputs, not approvals; r3 is authored by Curriculum Content for re-review.
Prerequisites are concepts, not approved canonical code edges.
Identity relationships and component decomposition require Architecture decision.
Proposed atomic component labels are code-free and create no canonical identities.
No mapping, assessment, mastery or jurisdiction coverage is conferred.

inclusions: Two-input a+b with integers a,b>=0 and a+b<=20
Two-input a-b with integers 0<=b<=a<=20
Zero operands and zero results
Use of diagrams, counting, decomposition or mental strategies
misconception_probes: Count-on includes the initial number as an increment
assessment_criteria: Independent correct evidence for addition AND subtraction
Both crossing-ten and non-crossing-ten cases
Include zero and 20 boundaries
Allow equivalent correct strategies
Do not infer contextual mastery or fluency

inclusions: One-operation discrete nonnegative quantity situations
Join situations with result, change or start unknown
Separate situations with result, change or start unknown
Put-together/take-apart situations with part or whole unknown
Compare situations with difference, larger or smaller quantity unknown
All modeled quantities, including every inferred answer, in 0..20
Model or equation tied to a contextual answer
exclusions: Any quantity including unknown greater than 20

examples.input: Start with 7, end with 12: how many added?
Some counters; add 5, ending with 12: start?
12 counters; some removed, leaving 7: how many removed?
7 red and 5 blue counters: how many total?
12 total, 7 red: how many are not red?
A has 12 and B has 7: how many more does A have?
B has 7; A has 5 more: how many does A have?
A has 12, five more than B: how many does B have?

misconception_probes: Treats the word 'more' as an instruction to add
Reverses the compared and reference quantities
Answers without interpreting units or unknown position
assessment_criteria: Satisfy every required structure and unknown-role cell in assessment_evidence_matrix
Retain per-cell evidence rather than collapsing attempts into arithmetic accuracy
Evaluate story-to-equation or story-to-model translation independently from calculation
Require the final answer to identify the contextual quantity
Accept valid inverse-operation, object and drawing strategies
Do not award the composite claim from result-unknown prompts alone

assessment_evidence_matrix.rule: A composite mastery claim requires independent, unassisted evidence for every listed role; evidence for one cell never satisfies another.
evidence_separation: Score situation-to-model translation separately from arithmetic execution
Require contextual interpretation with the correct quantity and unit
Accept mathematically equivalent equations, inverse operations, objects or drawings
Hinted or keyword-only responses do not satisfy independent evidence

inclusions: Forward by ones from arbitrary start in 0..120 without exceeding 120
Compare two integers in 0..120 using <, =, or >
Explicitly separate evidence for the two components
exclusions: Reading and writing arbitrary numerals as a separate skill
Assuming place-value understanding solely from ordering
prerequisite_concepts: hundreds concept when explaining 100..120 in base ten
misconception_probes: Infers comparison competence from reciting a sequence
assessment_criteria: Architecture must decide atomic identities before any canonical promotion
Store counting and comparison evidence separately
If retained as a profile, require both atomic results without duplicating mastery credit
Count from nonzero arbitrary starts and across 99/100
Compare <, = and > including pairs around 100
Do not infer backward, skip, collection-counting, numeral-writing or place-value mastery

inclusions: Continue a forward-by-one whole-number sequence from an arbitrary start in 0..120 without exceeding 120
Cross the 99-to-100 boundary
exclusions: Numeral reading or writing as a separate skill
assessment_evidence: At least one sequence crossing 99 to 100

inclusions: Compare two whole numbers in 0..120 by magnitude
Represent less than, equal to and greater than relationships
exclusions: Ordering lists of three or more numbers unless separately included
Assuming place-value explanation from a correct symbol alone
assessment_evidence: Explanation or representation sampled separately when required

composite_policy_if_retained.rule: A composite result is the conjunction of separately stored atomic results.
prohibitions: No replacement of atomic attempt history

inclusions: Two-digit whole numbers 10..99
Canonical n=10*t+u with 1<=t<=9 and 0<=u<=9
Ten ones may be regrouped as one ten
Teens and multiples of ten including zero ones
exclusions: Requiring noncanonical regroupings such as 3 tens + 15 ones for 45
misconception_probes: Claims the 4 in 45 represents four units
Fails to treat a group of ten as ten units
Equates any valid regrouping with canonical digits
assessment_criteria: Explain ten-as-a-unit with objects, diagrams or grouping
Link numerals, digit values and canonical expanded form
Include teen and zero-ones cases
Distinguish 4 from 40 in 45
Do not infer noncanonical regrouping mastery
